data.rationale: Scenario-owned durable data observed in the canonical data directory.

budget.rationale: Durable storage is bounded by the workload byte ceiling; it is alarm-only because the data is not regenerable.

logs.rationale: Scenario operational logs observed in the canonical logs directory.

budget.rationale: Regenerable storage is retained for 30 days and reclaimed by age; the window is the workload retention requirement.

storage.rationale: Storage surfaces are declared from observed canonical scenario directories; external resource databases are not claimed by this scenario.

service.name: knowledge-observatory
service.description: Real-time monitoring and management of Vrooli's semantic knowledge system - acts as a consciousness monitor for collective intelligence

qdrant.description: Primary vector database containing all semantic knowledge to monitor and search

ollama.description: Dense embeddings for hybrid documentation search and the LLM-as-reranker fallback

postgres.description: Optional relational source for observatory metadata

reranker.description: Cross-encoder reranker (BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3 via TEI) that reorders the fused hybrid-search shortlist for the strongest result ordering.
reranker.degraded_behavior: Reranking falls back to the qwen3:4b LLM reranker, then to raw RRF-fused order; search still returns results, only the final ordering is less precise.

agent-manager.description: Optional coding-agent execution for deep documentation search and documentation healing. Agent Manager owns portable profile reconciliation and resource-owned runner/model selection.
agent-manager.degraded_behavior: Documentation indexing and standard health checks continue when Agent Manager is unavailable; deep-search and document-healing actions return a clear unavailable error.

search-hub.description: Federated search router. knowledge-observatory self-registers its `knowledge-observatory.docs` provider (descriptor + tuning + tests) from `.vrooli/search.json` at boot so search-hub can route to it and run quality sweeps. Registration is an idempotent upsert.
search-hub.degraded_behavior: If search-hub is down at boot, self-registration retries briefly then gives up; KO serves docs search normally and re-registers on its next boot.
